title: Linear velocity formula
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be the correct expression for orbital speed, v = 2πr / T.

title: Mass from orbital motion
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be the correct expression for the central mass, M = (4π²r³) / (G T²).

title: Surface gravity derivation
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) must be the correct expression for surface gravity, g = (4π²r³) / (R² T²).

title: Applying Newton's second law
description: Important: The solution must equate gravitational force to the centripetal force for the satellite (GMm/r² = m v²/r).

title: Relating g to M and R
description: Important: The solution must correctly relate surface gravitational acceleration to the body's mass and radius (g = GM/R²).

title: Correct variable usage
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student confuses the orbital radius (r) with the body's radius (R) in any formula.

title: Algebraic manipulation
description: Optional: The solution shows clear, step-by-step algebra to derive the final expressions from the fundamental equations.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The solution includes a brief check that the derived formulas have the correct dimensions for velocity, mass, and acceleration.
